notes.title: Ship of Heroes Announces Pricing and Launch Details
notes.content:
Launch date and time
Ship of Heroes will become available Monday September 22, 2025 at 2:30 PM EST.


Pricing
The initial download and an active subscription will give access to everything in the game. There are no microtransactions, no cash shop, no premium addons, no deluxe launch package. The initial download of $60 plus an active subscription gives access to everything currently in the game and added in the two years after launch. One month access is included in the initial download fee.

Once in the game, players can choose their term of subscription:

1 month: $15

3 months: $42 (Save 7%)

6 months: $78 (Save 13%)

Yearly: $144 (20%)

Screenshot

Microtransactions on the Steam store page refers only to the subscription, as it is implemented through the Steam microtransaction system. There are no actual microtransactions in Ship of Heroes.


What is included
·       10 character slots

·       The full character creator and costume collection

·       5 archetypes; 240 powers

·       Fast travel powers such as flight

·       Missions and raids

·       Housing

·       2,500 Unobtainium Dust (in game currency) for your first character


Recommended System Requirements
OS: Windows 10 or 11

Processor: Intel core i7-8700 4.60 GHz or AMD Ryzen 5 3600

Memory: 32 GB RAM

Graphics: NVIDIA® GeForce® RTX 3000 series or above / AMD Radeon RX 6600 or above

DirectX: Version 11

Storage: 35 GB available space

 
Account Wipe
Characters in existing accounts will be returned to level 1 and their progress will be wiped (missions and achievements). Powers, equipped augments, infusions, inventory items will be removed. So will housing.

Character name and appearances will be retained. The appearance of characters created many years ago may have been altered by the many changes to the character creator.

You will be able to choose your archetype and starting powers for your existing characters either in the character creator or by visiting a Power Trainer.

We are grateful to those who helped us test the game during development. As a thank you, those players will start with the Beta Tester badge.



For questions, please post on ShipofHeroes.com/forum or fill a contact form on the website.

notes.title: Teaming is Fun and Rewarding
notes.content:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43837291/9046832e805ec75f8297dce265841b3c82b2a4e0.png"]

Teaming is fun! We’ve incorporated the best suggestions from beta players and the best ideas from other MMORPGs into our team play. The result is very satisfying already, and it’s only going to get better from here.


​You’re not forced to join teams


Most parts of SoH can be played solo. Right now, the only exceptions are our two large raids. They contain spectacular fights and give good loot, but players who’d rather solo can earn the same items elsewhere. So, when you do join a team, or a raid league, you know that everyone else chose team play over soloing. They aren’t being forced or pressured into it.


​Team sizes are flexible up to 10


No mission requires a specific team size. Team sizes are flexible up to 10 members. Bigger teams face bigger enemy groups with more elite foes among them. The most challenging battles also scale in this way, rewarding advanced team compositions and tactics, but the default difficulty leaves plenty of room for experimentation.



Our devs have done a lot of combat balance testing while on teams. There’s always more to improve, but missions like Prize Crew are now quite fun for any team size… and quite challenging, if the team leader turns the difficulty up. Do not expect to succeed on the higher difficulties without dying a bunch!



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43837291/bf18d8b411be44189aebc3ede39db9a36dc75295.png"]Enemies on default settings aren't too bad, though.


Teaming has its benefits


It takes time to form a team, and coordination gets harder the bigger the team is. So the total experience, dust, and items earned are modestly increased the larger the team is. The number of team members determining your bonus is shown under your health bar. Mouse over it to see your team boost.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43837291/69bac9cf60eaa8fee57c08f3d59af432f2858eb5.png"]It's satisfying to see the number go up as the team grows.


Leaders get extra rewards


Team leaders get a slightly larger bonus than team members on the same size of team, but they also have more responsibilities. In raids, the team leaders report to a league leader, who gets another small boost, as thanks for organizing the entire raid. Again, the goal is to balance the reward with the extra effort of managing a group. Leaders can also transfer leadership, set the mission’s difficulty for everyone, kick troublemakers from their team or league, and teleport everyone in the same map to their location to help keep things organized.
Raid leaders get additional extra powers.​



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43837291/e3372bd201fc4720c83ae227cce537a1fe04295f.png"]"Time to run!"


You can team up with anyone thanks to sidekicking and mentoring


Team members of different levels are raised or lowered to one level away from the leader, so every player can make a difference. If you are sidekicked, your number of powers does not increase but the powers you do have do more damage.
Team leaders set the mission difficulty for everyone in General Settings. The difficulty level must be set before you enter the instance. This setting adjusts not only the difficulty, but the rewards. Greater challenge, greater rewards.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43837291/f2350de94ea3f1b251784f6cff0111b707b83e90.png"]Each level of difficulty is a big change.




​Your reputation matters


There’s no matchmaking system in SoH, intentionally. Most teams will be formed by talking in broadcast chat or within your supergroup. This design makes it harder to silently speedrun missions with strangers. It encourages making friends organically by doing missions together. Friendly behavior will give you more people who’ll want to do other missions with you later. The SoH community is amazingly nice and helpful overall.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43837291/71b0c69c5624c5df6d740c6afb72b47639cbb1c2.png"]"If Gold is here to tank, we can focus on maximum damage."




Inviting players to your team


There are several ways to invite people to a team:
• You can click the social button under the compass at the top of the screen to see and invite anyone nearby.
• Right-click on a player, or on a targeted player’s portrait in the upper-right, to invite that person.
• For distant players, you can type the chat command /invite with the target’s name instead.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43837291/bcb215bb04c8fdd4a20d988fb948e607727f87ee.png"]

The other options are all useful, too.


A world designed for teaming


Ever felt that the rooms were too big when playing solo? Now imagine the same room with 10 players, their pets, and a matching number of enemies. Or better yet, try it. It could be quite crowded.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43837291/7eb12dec8f65a3be0712c33d6668ee38a69c2a5d.png"]

​"You could fit a whole football team in here... and they will, on higher difficulties!"


Where is the rest of my team?


As a team member, you can find your team on the map (Press M) and the minimap; they are the little green dots. But instead of running back to them, you can use the universal power Regroup to teleport back to your team leader.
The team leader also automatically has the Assemble power to gather his or her team to them.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43837291/5513ba6e28ff01b23881cccc1372d7ac50772636.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43837291/74a94fbe33d4c7b89e602d1f369b5c24701d3ad4.png"]Some universal powers are just for fun, but others are critical.


Different builds and powers are better for solo or for teaming


Every possible hero has some ability to fight alone, and some ability to fight on a normal team, but even within the same powersets, some are much better at one playstyle. For example, AoE powers like Fireball and Flash of Insight are very strong on a big team, with many allies to buff or heal and enemies to burn at once. But single-target powers like Plasma Bolt and Jinxed are great in intense solo fights.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43837291/9f5aa1afb7018e7835efe5a60892b19dc250af61.jpg"]Aiming heals where the team will be in two seconds takes some skill.


It’s easy to follow the story as a team member


Unless you choose to disable voiceover audio, you’ll hear the mission contact’s spoken dialog from anywhere in the game, even if the team leader walks away. In addition, each spoken line is recorded in the special dialog tab of the chat window, so you can read it at any time.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43837291/1c608b16c8e8f6ac62002d55556a03d4877492d1.png"]


Future Developments


We hope to add options to directly invite people in your supergroup, the SoH name for guilds, and in your friends list. But for now, the other three methods all work.

We also have more QoL improvements queued up for release.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43837291/863e15a5015364e2999ef93372b81e3c4b3b1415.png"]

"A glowing enemy? Everyone, use some infusions!"

notes.title: Art Direction in Ship of Heroes
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=Z1oYNEmLTJ4;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43837291/94baf5d10169ee9c62309c3f3ba0fce2b997d110.png
Enter the halls of power and make your mark on history.

Ship of Heroes is an exciting new Sci-Fi MMORPG with beautiful vistas and thoughtful art direction. In today's video, you'll see several of our favorite in-game scenes that highlight the varied visuals of SoH. All scenes are exactly the way players would see them except for the minimized UI. In our video, there are no cinematic cutscenes slowly rendered at movie quality to hide how the game really looks.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43837291/e70ce1d0f52874994860c046aec57a8e009c7813.png
Meet interesting aliens - and blow up their warships from the inside.

There are not too many PC MMORPGs where you can join a 50-man raid and rain fire, throw lightning, or blast beams of dark magic on a giant boss together. Or even hold a costume contest with 50 unique costumes in a line. Of those, fewer still can compare to SoH visually. So, in our market niche, we are one of the best looking games available. And our top-notch art direction is a big part of the reason why.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43837291/e46dae349e0a1b6a3674aca7c31f3a213416a4a8.png
A picture is worth a thousand words.

Art Direction Done Right

Art direction is about making countless small, aesthetic choices that all need to fit the themes, mood, tone, mechanics, platform, and audience of a game. You want enough consistency that every location, enemy, and UI menu is part of a cohesive whole, and enough change to keep your players entertained. Ship of Heroes delivers on both fronts.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43837291/173bbbadfa5b3ac700243776eb72f5108d639ef7.png
Even old maintenance areas get auto-cleaned in the far future.

For example, the FHS Justice is over 200 years old. It's been expanded and rebuilt many times, so certain low-priority areas look much older and more worn than the gleaming streets. But both were clearly made by the same species. Alien ships look like they were manufactured by different species, with different thought processes. And cleaning nanites are commonplace, especially in spaceships, so you won't find a lot of trash outside of recent combat zones. In contrast, the temporary mining colony on New California has a functional look and is not as well maintained. Only the teleport pad that the whole colony relies on is more sophisticated.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43837291/c46256c8547027a6d455d63ac223e153fc5ecf4c.png
The functional look of the New California mining colony town

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43837291/fa1ceb718a17e4e5f7f9b00d939a8cf5a022a6eb.png
The sophisticated New California teleport pad

The future on display in SoH is a bright one, full of advancements and wonder. Far away from the influence of Earth, the massive city-ship F.H.S. Justice is clean, beautiful, and prosperous. But a bright light casts the darkest shadows; the ship is also beset by threats, internal and external. As a hero, you'll find yourself in conflict with many groups, for many reasons. Murderous space aliens. Cunning cyborg kidnappers. Secret societies. Gruff mercenaries willing to do dirty deeds for the right price. And the list goes on... The beautiful environments support this story dynamic, showing you what most heroes are fighting for.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43837291/7dfa95a1a9af79e77dc026260e396bb3e9ad9de9.png
Sometimes, you just have to fight bad guys inside a giant plasma cannon, while it's firing.

SoH can be played on a wide variety of computers. You can focus on FPS or maximize the graphical fidelity of the immersive FX as you prefer. Players get both text and voiced NPC interactions, and can set their own balance for voice volume, music, and sound FX separately.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43837291/d402be3089aeadabbcd887775309b114a739cef2.jpg
The defaults work well, but you have a lot of room to make changes, too.

But setting the defaults well is also part of good art direction. For example, shadows tend to strain your PC much more than graphical upgrades like antialiasing, or even high-res textures, especially when there are 100 other characters nearby. So, we use selective shadows and strong antialiasing to enable big raids that still look good.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43837291/634856c50c5491af1ac5f2b6825ad41f6b60842a.png
Heroes and skyscrapers alike cast shadows.

Ship of Heroes is easy to learn but challenging to master. Even the UI gives you much more control and many more customization options than usual. You'll end up combining many combat powers, utility powers like flight, consumable items, info about your teammates, positioning, and more. In a way, it's almost like a grand strategy game. Our professional art direction keeps the screen looking nice even on the hardest difficulties, where you'll need to track a lot of information to win.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43837291/2d816b71b88cde6f8157a62e39687e304dfd2fe4.png
All of those pretty icons at the bottom are useful.

If you've ever wanted to explore a completely new and innovative MMORPG, discover secrets no one else has found yet, and be able to say: “I was playing the day the game launched,” be sure to wishlist Ship of Heroes on Steam.

Technical Notes
1.	SoH has made a commitment to transparency, so we do not publish slick marketing videos with impossible graphics and pretend that they're gameplay. We generally use the current Steam version of the game to produce our cutscenes. And we're proud of how SoH gameplay footage compares to similar in-game videos of other MMORPGs. Even some with much larger budgets don't match up.

2.	Like all smart dev teams working in the Unreal Engine, we use some of the best purchased assets along with our many custom-built ones. However, we almost never use characters, props, buildings or other items right out of the box. They usually aren’t consistent with our art direction – or our polygon standards. Usually, we have to upgrade and alter them substantially before putting them into the game.

3.	Minimizing the UI is not just a dev privilege. Players can minimize the UI by pressing ALT + U or select which UI element you see. Fighting with the UI hidden is harder, though. 

4.	Like most MMORPGs, SoH will look much prettier depending on your computer's CPU, GPU, internet connection speed, and what other programs it's trying to run, plus how busy the servers are. We provide players with significant controls to offset these impacts to some degree.

notes.title: 2024 In Review
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43837291/ad42707b5e932002dfe69dd5e8f822f34a2aa134.png
One of our favorite new costumes created this year!

The biggest news of 2024 has been our announcement that Ship of Heroes will be launching in Q2 2025. All year, we've been preparing the game for launch by adding, improving, and polishing one area after another. So 2024 has been a year of tremendous progress.


Visual FX get a boost

Our attention turned to visual FX and animations first, so we spruced them up to make fights even cooler. The VFX are now more consistent for each powerset, so skilled heroes can tell what kind of powers you’re using at a glance. But our greatest achievement in 2024 with VFX was to individually review every combat effect in the game, one by one, to identify which ones de-served an upgrade. This herculean task has been completed.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43837291/044c1b88b97e956ba7cfb9a6607a14e8f53be604.png
That never grows old!


Comprehensive animation upgrade

We also reviewed every combat animation in the game! There are hundreds, and some are subtly different for men and women. After polishing and improving animations for all powers when they're used on the ground, we moved on to in-flight combat animations. Reaction animations were also expanded and improved. Finally, several major enemies like the Berserker got new animations appropriate for their special status.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43837291/1fd760bf425baf917bb467edda4031f059201290.gif
Sometimes, playing SoH can feel like you’re in an action movie.


Raids upgraded

Speaking of big raids, we’ve made major improvements to our raid system. We made these changes based on the answers we received on the raid survey that hundreds of you completed in early 2024. We again thank those of you who took the time to tell us what you found most fun (and not fun) in raids.

We added a sophisticated raid GUI that makes it much easier to organize players into teams. Ship of Heroes enables both small and large raids, and our UI reflects this, accommodating up to 10 teams of up to 10 heroes each, plus a raid leader. Players can be moved from one team to another by the leader. Our sidekicking system temporarily boosts team members to nearly the level of the team or raid leader, so low-level heroes can make a big difference, even on high-level raids. And raids scale up or down with the number of players, so they're easy to form or join, and fun at any size.

The raid leader and team leaders in a raid get some special powers to assist them with managing the raid. They also get enhanced rewards to match the extra work they're doing to make raids fun for everyone else who joins up. 

Individual raids have also seen many improvements, notably the Winter Raid and the Berserker Invasion. Work is ongoing on the New California Raid and the Mothership Raid, and we expect that these two will be added as free expansions after launch.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43837291/e413eebb47c04a3e4ef2fdc89844e68d51605776.png
Now that’s what I call teamwork!


All NPC dialog is voiced

We've been testing voiced dialog for years now. Despite our limited budget, the result was generally well-received. Now we’ve not only extended voicing to almost all NPCs, but improved overall voice quality as well. So if you'd rather listen to a conversation than read blocks of text, keep the sound on, and enjoy!

For those who think, "What did that guy say just before the fight started?" We’ve also added a new tab to the chat box allowing you to see the NPC dialog that's relevant to you – including conversations your team leader has with mission contacts. Now you can read all of it at your leisure, if you want to.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43837291/0502d1a337e0073e2560a6c3c809072aac3eac3c.png
Conversations are so much more realistic with distinctive voices.


Quality of life changes

Many small but important QoL changes have been made - too many to list them all. But here's a partial summary. We’ve added a mission difficulty slider in General Settings, so that you can modify the enemies you'll face. This is done dynamically, so you'll face big crowds and boss enemies with dangerous attacks more often at higher difficulties, not just the same enemies with x2 health and damage. And the reverse applies if you turn it down to easy. The option is there for a reason, after all.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43837291/1ca179562db78720f5825dedc70053570a40dfab.png
Go ahead, crank the difficulty up to max… if you dare.

As discussed above, the chat has two new tabs, including one to read the dialog of the mission, in case your team moves on too fast for you to absorb it all. We also pulled most of the “drop” notices off of the screen and into a dedicated tab where you can check them at any time, with-out interrupting your concentration during combat.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43837291/517e1f828086b2bd78e4474fda5ddd4e4367fd49.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43837291/a4373e97b9f013f564ef0a4560c5ca7c2bba0a15.png
“Am I hoarding a huge pile of loot? Nooo…”- A hero with bulging pockets

Maps can now zoom out far enough to show either the whole map or most of it, and the majority of GUI elements can be resized independently of each other.


Character Creator

We have continued to add to the character creator with a large Viking-themed costume set for all three body types. Twenty-five new auras are now available for all players to enjoy, in addition to the previous five. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43837291/fbe539553114cb60f3e747058622b3777659712a.png
The fiery aura looks pretty snazzy.


Auction House

A Beta version of the auction house is working, and it will receive further improvements before launch. But we expect to get a lot of feedback about the auction house after launch, and we'll take requests into account for prioritizing upgrades.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43837291/9d580d64c73715757f9691a537316dbc3feddaee.png
Now you too can have a mercantile empire!


Mystery Mission

We've added a unique, fairly easy, story-focused mission called Training Mishap that you'll be offered at the end of Character Creation. You can also get it in Apotheosis City later on. Exploring the malfunctioning training area can reveal early hints about a hidden enemy group from a future update, and expand on the lore for an existing enemy group. We won't give away anything too specific... but keep an eye out for hidden areas!

Thank you for continuing to support us this past year. You can look forward to more news from us in the next few months as we get Ship of Heroes ready to launch. We hope you're as excited as we are!


Technical Notes

1.	We’ve made some improvements to the backend to reduce lag.

2.	We’ve focused a lot on the network processes that communicate between the servers and the client. This extra layer isn't needed for single player and turn-based multiplayer games, but it's very important for true MMORPGs with lots of players.

3.	We're also working on a more sophisticated setup for a test server. In short: it's complicated. But it's getting there.

4.	We’re involved in a major effort to increase our depth of integration with Steam. Each time we do a major test or a public event, we learn more, and make improvements that will make your experience a little bit smoother.

notes.title: Release Window Announced
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=grJmdK5bxTE;full][/previewyoutube]

New MMORPG Ship of Heroes will launch in Q2 2025! Many parts of the game are working and integrated and launch-ready now, so we’re fairly confident about this date. Right now, we’re fixing bugs and filling in the last gaps, which should take 4-6 months. And SoH already includes some exciting features that many modern MMORPGs lack.

Ship of Heroes is a PVE superhero sci-fi MMORPG set in the far future, aboard a generation ship called the FHS Justice, home to Apotheosis City.  The future is bright; humans and friendly aliens have superpowers, advanced technology, and magic. But many dangers lurk in the shadows, and the Justice needs heroes to face them.​

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43837291/bb390c383a53cb3d09aa639cc65d7b7342e9aa00.png

Create your own, unique hero to play, and write a personal backstory that other heroes can read.  Make friends – and enemies – among the many voiced characters aboard the ship. Play solo or join teams right from the beginning; even at level 1, you can make a difference on high-level superhero teams and in major raids.  Select a handful of powers to rely on out of hundreds, then customize their effects with complex augments.  Craft, buy, and sell powerful items in the auction house. Design your own plush superhero lair, then invite your friends over.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43837291/bd5b4b8e4d4632cae5d81447b05021e57de30042.jpg

Five Archetypes, Hundreds of Powers, Ten Character Slots

Ship of Heroes has five archetypes at launch, plus plans for more later. Each archetype has varied powersets and specific powers. These include unusual combinations of damage at different ranges, defensive powers, healing, buffing, debuffing, pets, mez/status effects, and more. Every hero has the potential to be good at 2 or even 3 things at once. So, it’d be hard to excel in every area, but you’re never locked into a narrow combat role unless you choose to be. And you can create up to ten characters to experiment with different builds.

 Tankers take hits for the team by using their melee powers to taunt enemies into  attacking them instead of their more fragile teammates. Tankers have offensive powersets and secondary powersets. They do moderate damage and are very tough.
 Brawlers wade into fights and deal large amounts of melee damage to groups of enemies. Brawlers have offensive primaries and defensive secondaries, the reverse of Tanks. They do high damage and are moderately tough.
 Devastators launch powerful range attacks at enemies while remaining out of range of enemy retribution. Devastators have offensive primaries and support secondaries. They do the highest damage and have moderately effective buffs designed to give them the ability to survive short but very intense fights.
 Support characters are quite varied: they heal and buff their teammates from a distance, keeping themselves out of range of powerful enemies. Support characters have support primaries and offensive secondaries. They do moderate damage and are excellent at making their allies more powerful, keeping a team alive.
 Controllers specialize in controlling and manipulating those around them through mesmerization, stuns and other mechanisms. Controller powers are control and status effects,  different from the powers of other  archetypes.
Locking down a horde of bad guys with a Controller can be very satisfying!

Power Augments – Better than Gear

In total, different heroes can access over 250 powers. The powers you choose to prioritize can each have up to 7 augments, which can affect that power, other powers, and even give passive boosts for an infinite variety of playstyles.

Everyone Gets Flight and Superspeed from Day 1

Part of this flexibility is mobility. You can fly anywhere, without relying on mounts or time-limited jetpacks, and run at incredible speeds. And all of these powers are designed to be used in combat. Even some enemies have adapted to heroes’ mobility, whether by flying themselves, or getting long-range weapons, or simply by knocking heroes out of the sky.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43837291/79bcbd21a64f950a9e150124b8a1c8b0cb8d6bbd.png
Keep an eye out for distant battles

Create Your Unique Look Independent of Archetype, Powers, or Level

Have you ever made a cool character, only to lose that look for the only armor with the highest stats? The Ship of Heroes character creator offers an impressive array of cosmetic customizations, letting you “mix and match” costumes in a variety of colors, styles, and body shapes. Your looks are not limited by your archetype, powers, or level, so you have complete design freedom.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43837291/a9930bb914ef580ade2506c611dd12b72978f7d7.png
Express your artistic side, then show it off in a big, beautiful city!

At launch, Ship of Heroes will have story-focused missions, challenge missions, task forces designed for teams of heroes, and big raids, all tested by veteran heroes. So, if you find a way to turn yourself inside-out by jumping into the water, take pride – that’s a real accomplishment!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43837291/f5db518b955df458ae00a159de06046c21a18448.gif

A Complex and Evolving World

Influence far-ranging events in a complex world where the voiced NPCs change, learn, and pursue their own goals as you get further in, just like you do. Your journey will take you to many exciting locations, and even to other planets!

Play with your Friends or Make New Ones, or Try the Hardest Content Solo…If You Dare

Teaming and raiding are incredibly flexible, but neither is required for progression. There’s no minimum team size, and up to ten heroes can team up to do most missions in the game. Raids can handle – and benefit from having – multiple teams. And the difficulty and rewards generally scale to keep things fun across very different group sizes and levels.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43837291/cecf6c8222722aae9ce2a03eb5507b3c75d7b7b8.png
Some bosses can launch you into another city block, so be careful. Or don’t…

Finding other players at the right level to join you will never be an issue again with our sidekicking system. When you join a team, your level is automatically raised to one level below the team leader’s until you leave. Or you can join inexperienced teams as a mentor, and you’ll automatically “hold back” by fighting at just above the team leader’s level.

Seasonal Content

We will have seasonal activities for at least for Halloween and Christmas, and perhaps other times of the year in the future.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43837291/bb52d1d2393770869efa85fbc4e2e64c16cb018b.png
Deck the halls, or deck your foes? Why not both?

A Big Thank You to our Supporters

To all our supporters, we’re thankful for your patience, and for the support and advice you’ve given us on the way to this point. We all hope to see you in-game when we launch.

Help Spread the Word about Ship of Heroes

Ship of Heroes is an ambitious project for an indie team of our size. We lack the AAA resources to simply buy tons of visibility. You can help Ship of Heroes succeed by wishlisting it to give us more exposure on Steam, and by letting people in your network know about us. Every dollar we do not have to spend on promotion is a dollar that expands the game just a little bit more.

We will have a technical test next year, during which players will be able to sample Ship of Heroes and help us stress-test our server setup. Until then, you can join our testing team under NDA and tell us what you think to help us improve the game. We’re very responsive to feedback.

Launch is only the beginning. We plan to steadily expand the game with new stories, new challenges, new foes, and new worlds. A galaxy of adventures awaits!

Learn more at Ship of Heroes.com.

notes.title: October - November 2024 Update
notes.content:
In the last two months, we have implemented quite a few changes to improve the player’s experience. Some are fun additions; others are Quality of Life improvements. Here is a partial list, as some are too small to mention here.

There is a big new rez platform next to the hospital. You and your fellow heroes will be rezzed there if you die in the city. After you land at a random location on the platform, you will be touched by a beam of energy that will almost make you wish you could die again. Almost…

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43837291/a99d1be7f2032acc5bf6de047928796f2199bc28.png

We understand that sometimes, you want to challenge yourself, and other times, you want to do something very easy. Players can now select their level of difficulty between -2 and +3. The default setting is 0. This setting is found in the game menu. If you join a team or raid, your personal setting is overwritten by the team leader ‘s or raid leader’s choice.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43837291/1ca179562db78720f5825dedc70053570a40dfab.png

We have been working on raids and using this experience to stress the servers and communications between server and client. We are making successive, incremental changes to improve performance and reduce lag when playing with many characters and NPCs. Our objective is to enable as many players as possible to have a positive experience in our raid. 

As we are testing, we are also keeping an eye on areas we could improve. For example, we have updated the map markers in raids to show the league leader and team leaders in their team color, matching the raid UI color. Team members who are not leaders are only shown for the player’s current team. Your character is marked by a yellow frame around its health bar in the UI.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43837291/1ca179562db78720f5825dedc70053570a40dfab.png

We are continuing our animation upgrades to include enemies. Nagdellian enemies have now discovered multiple ways to die; they don’t all fall to the ground in the same way. The Berserker, their oversized and intimidating monster, now shows how hard he is to kill with a satisfying death animation. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43837291/1fd760bf425baf917bb467edda4031f059201290.gif

We will be testing the Berserker Invasion under NDA. If you are interested in participating, please register. You will also need to have signed as a tester under NDA.
In the crafting and trading area, we have added an auction house where players will be able to trade their drops and crafted items. Crafted infusions and augments will be more powerful than those purchased from infusions and augment vendors.  

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43837291/9d580d64c73715757f9691a537316dbc3feddaee.png

Ship of Heroes will launch with a tutorial mission and that mission is approaching completion. Many tutorial missions are boring. Ship of Heroes’ tutorial is part of the story and full of surprises in keeping with the rest of the game. Even if you think you do not need a tutorial, we hope you find it enjoyable to play on its own merit.

TECHNICAL NOTES

•	MMOs have a lot of communications going on between server and client. The larger the number of players and combat NPCs, the greater the number of communications. The multithreaded chat server does not just host chatting between players, it handles most of this communication.

•	Lag can be caused by the speed of the internet connection, other programs sharing this connection, physical distance between the server and the client, or how the communication is setup in the chat server. We are doing our best to eliminate the latter as a cause of lag.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43837291/e413eebb47c04a3e4ef2fdc89844e68d51605776.png

notes.title: Visual FX, Animations, and QoL Improvements
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=0N-8XLjA0pU;full][/previewyoutube]

This is a general update on how our program of polishing the game is proceeding.  We are currently upgrading the powers visual FX, improving consistency within each powerset. This builds on the ongoing animations upgrade. This video is a sneak peek at the results.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43837291/c78f144a784531a1301dc79da384ea9a6b2ab71f.png
Nothing says "Impending doom" quite like a big, flashy circle on the ground.

At the same time, we've also made quality of life improvements to superspeed, item drop notifications, and the way powers are displayed in the powers and power trainer popup windows.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43837291/c89188f645ba5acef0f5b0d1ff7163aa010a3235.png
Team fights can get a little intense...

There's good news for team players as well. In Ship of Heroes, when your team leader is speaking with a mission contact, you can stand nearby to hear the voice lines. Everyone on the team can read everything in the dialog tab of the chat window, including what the team leader says to the NPCs. So even if you’re just following a team leader along, you can get the whole story of the mission later by reading the dialog tab, at your own speed. Solo players can also see the dialog in the dialog tab.   

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43837291/82d4a84294200db3185fe4fad94d19257d86c1a7.png
Ever finish a battle, and then wonder what the bad guy was yapping about? Wonder no more!

Superspeeding is highlighted with a speed lines effect at the edge of the screen. We received feedback that it induced motion sickness in some. You can now toggle off this effect in the General tab of Interface Settings.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43837291/f2b3fcebfb5078b281691e40cafaa749ccfcee06.png
There are many gadgets and enchantments to negate the speed effect, but some heroes think it's cool.

When a ranged, targeted AOE attack power is on cooldown, the targeting decal is black and white stripes, not red, until the power recharges.  This is to tell the player that he is targeting an area, but that the power is not yet available.  As soon as the power is recharged, the targeting circle turns red, showing that the power is recharged and ready to fire.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43837291/f44bf51de7acffc8673e844fcec898d0239d3294.png

Testers told us that all this helpful text flashing on the screen was a bit much: locations, warning, drops, gained levels… So, we did something about it. Item drops don't flash on the screen anymore, except for the rarest ones. They are all displayed on the “Drops” tab of the chat window, where you can inspect them after finishing the mission or monitor them while playing.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43837291/82d4a84294200db3185fe4fad94d19257d86c1a7.png

The level-up message will still flash with a badge icon, reminding you to visit a power trainer to select an additional power, and/or an augment vendor to equip additional augments when you have empty slots. Power trainers and augment vendors usually work in pairs, and the one you need to see next will waive at you. The power trainer window now clearly displays the names of your primary and secondary powersets, as well.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43837291/e70cb63b674f8548c56b149badae701a6ff8f8fc.png
Don't forget to pick a few secondary powers by clicking the tab for them. Some are quite strong!

On the powers window viewed by pressing P, we clarified the mysterious meaning of “P”, “S”, and “M”.  “P” means your primary powerset, and “S” means your secondary powerset.  Your primary and secondary powersets are now identified by name. “M” used to be limited to movement powers, but now it contains a variety of universal powers.  We’ve added a row for temporary powers, too, since these can be quite important in mission gameplay.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43837291/42acd647396fd8ed53e397cca6a7d21bbd58aeef.png
Veterans of our many Betas will recognize some of these powers on sight.

In addition to UI Scaling, more windows can now be individually resized. Players have more flexibility to adapt their UI to their playstyle and screen resolution.

The big map, viewed by pressing M, is bigger and fancier than ever before. Its maximum size has increased, and when zooming out, you can now see the entire map of Apotheosis City. Dragging the map and zooming in bring details into view. The transparency slider lets you monitor the surroundings while getting your bearings.

You can now see other players' catchphrases and hero descriptions, as well as your own. Just click the hero you want to read about, right-click his portrait in the upper-right, and select "Inspect".

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43837291/dbcb92adcd170cfa4fc2ecfc7b26f78c20ffa91b.png
Many people write up little backstories in the CCT for their favorite heroes!

Technical Notes

 All powers up to level 50 are being upgraded as we plan for future expansions.  Even though the current plan is to launch with powers up to level 20, SoH is built with growth in mind.

 The character sheet showing the character catchphrase is not shown here as it is undergoing a makeover.

 The new map features are currently implemented only on the Apotheosis City map. We are methodically rolling them out to all other maps.  

 The active mission title is green in the mission tracker.  This is important, since you're free to take on multiple missions at the same time, and you'll want to keep track of which one the map is pointing you towards.

 As you can tell, our primary focus at the moment is on polishing and perfecting Ship of Heroes for an eventual launch.  If you have ideas you want to share with us, please post your idea in the forums or send them to us on a contact form. 

Wishlist us and signup for opportunities to play at https://shipofheroes.com/

When we first started showing off the character creator in Ship of Heroes, we promised that we would make it bigger and better as the game evolved.  And we’ve kept that promise – adding standard faces, many, many new costumes, and other features.

Characters can look good with and without auras.  It all depends on what story you want to tell with each avatar you create. notes.title: Raids in Ship of Heroes
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=idFwgbvRktw;full][/previewyoutube]

Joining raids should be fun. Different raids should be accessible throughout the game, not just as end-game content, and they should reward gameplay skills and organizational leadership skills. But raiding is also a social activity, and many of us don’t want to be stressed when we socialize. How do we balance these ideas? We let players decide whether they want to lead a raid and earn extra rewards for accepting the challenges of leadership. If not, you can join a raid and just follow your team leader, blast enemies, heal friends, and chat at times while you do it. Because sometimes you feel like leading, and sometimes you don’t.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43837291/e2706ddfea9dbb1efe7b7739dccc406c3ddea53d.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43837291/52738aee40c9313f3e100e4de96afff6ef62dca5.png
“The Winter Queen? Not my problem. I am just a healer.”

We aim to create raids with big, interesting activities that benefit from having lots of players and make it easy to interact with friends. Of course, killing murderous monsters and getting great rewards is also good. Perhaps saving all of mankind, now and again. And having fun while doing it. On most of our raids, you can join your friends with a character of any level. You will then be brought to within one level of the league leader, or sidekicked. Only the harder raids have level requirements.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43837291/622625bbfbb30fae8c1f0a32d19268b9b9edd3e4.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43837291/75f91e678b7bd698fe87d678554a421be1ff4aeb.png
“There goes my ride. Guess I’ll have to teleport to the Arch, then walk…”


Raids can be very emotionally engaging, whether they go well... or not. Many players who answered our raid survey are still carrying around anger from events that happened in some raid they did years ago in another game. The best solution is to play SoH and enjoy better raids with nicer people.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43837291/a9bda4abb4fb547f5209497bf52a5d54d0aabe50.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43837291/52738aee40c9313f3e100e4de96afff6ef62dca5.png
“Do not try to “solo” giant cyborg dinosaurs. Do I really need to say that?” - Ambassador

One common source of frustration is when one inattentive player makes a mistake, and the whole raid fails. The only thing worse than this is actually being the unlucky person who causes the whole raid to fail. We’re designing raids that make it quite difficult to be “that guy.” But at the same time, we’re looking for chances for each team to really impact a raid's progress and success. So good performance leads to winning faster, but one mistake won't wipe the raid. We plan to eventually add a couple of really hard raids. But in other raids, a single mistake by one player will not wipe the raid.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43837291/9c1e5d5590a79e54d0ca0de3e4dfd8fce7e8199e.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43837291/cda031e9de6be86f4c82038f7039288892cba655.png
Blasting enemies feels good at any level. 

Our raids accept different team sizes. Difficulty scales to the total number of players in the league, regardless of team structures, and to the level of the leader. As a result, our raids are vastly more accessible and less rigid. The flexibility of team sizes will make it easier to form raid leagues. We are designing early raids to be easier and less demanding than some of the raids we’re developing for higher levels, so people who want a challenge can still find it.  And we’ll be making rapid adjustments to raids as the feedback comes in, just like we've done with missions and powers in previous Betas. 


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43837291/23d185799fa1481dcaea2ff3205f24ae07366c2a.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43837291/f8039075899a02065124c5d3ee7d214daed8e264.png
“Are the good guys winning? Should I cheer, or run?” – Confused bystander


Some survey respondents were interested in very large raids. So, our raids have the potential to be BIG. Huge, even. The minimum number of heroes that can fight a Winter Raid is 30, at least for now. The current maximum is 101, with up to 10 teams, and those numbers might grow even larger in the future. Leading 100 fellow players is quite challenging, so raid leaders get extra powers, plus team leaders to help organize and control the raid. And a level 1 player can both join and contribute to the success of this raid. The era of the big raid has returned - and we did not have to sacrifice graphics to get it.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43837291/fcf7b6dcbe426d926f7c8585079b698bc663d9b3.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43837291/52738aee40c9313f3e100e4de96afff6ef62dca5.png
"Now this is my kind of party! Everything's on fire!" - Meltdown


SoH raids have a place for every archetype and for every level. In the video clip below, you can see the King of Winter being held in place by a controller during one of our tests. Big raid bosses usually can't be disabled or mezzed by status effects all the time, or the raids would be boring. But they can be mezzed periodically, giving everyone else time to heal, move to new positions, or throw their strongest attacks.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43837291/6571e1cf2e6709c40eb1a5678f1e50b4956b6e9c.gif
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43837291/52738aee40c9313f3e100e4de96afff6ef62dca5.png
Having a Tanker ready for when the holds wear off is highly recommended.

Raids conclude with a summary screen of what the raid league achieved and who were the biggest contributors. What is different is that SoH shows contributions other than damage, like heals, buffs, and debuffs. There is really a reason to bring each archetype to a raid, and recognition of their contributions. These features, and keeping the chat positive, will make the entire raid experience much more pleasant.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43837291/d0136ee7fb561c3e1f46ce52fb8acb63d4b3e3ac.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43837291/52738aee40c9313f3e100e4de96afff6ef62dca5.png
“Ugh, the Brawlers got impaled again. Who has AoE heals ready?”

For healers and buffers, the raid UI is a critical tool: you can click on any character’s nameplate to target, heal, or buff them through the UI, without needing to find or click them in the large crowd. So, you can focus on who to heal, and not on standing right next to them, as long as you're in the same general area.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43837291/c5fd0ffccad06449d6f57dbae3da11864d227050.png

The silver and gold teams took heavy damage in this raid.



{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43837291/14fed3dcd41ab6cde7f22d5bcc16b6aa0fb7190c.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43837291/f8039075899a02065124c5d3ee7d214daed8e264.png
They are not called Berserkers because of their positive attitude.

Technical Notes:
1.	For those wonder how MMOs work behind the scenes, all the information like your current health, your friends list, your team number, your alive/dead status and even your archetype is being networked through a server by our new multi-threaded chat system. 

2.	Loot will be automatically shared, and griefers will not be able to cheat their teammates out of loot by dropping out of the raid.

3.	Each raid is designed so that multiple paths to success are possible, and experimentation will likely uncover options that the dev team never thought of. We look forward to seeing some crazy tactics!

4.	Playing multiple times, and completing it with multiple archetypes, is the best way to develop high expertise in leading that raid. It will also make you a more skilled player in general. What you know about other builds is almost as important as your own build.

notes.title: New Voices Bring the Story to Life
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=cmKkRLHZvi4;full][/previewyoutube]

Ship of Heroes has always been a story MMORPG, and in the past, we have published about the backstory, the major characters, the setting and the many challenges that humanity faces in the future.  We decided a few years back that providing character voices for our NPCs was much superior to text-only, which is used in many older MMORPGs.  In fact, quite a few older MMOs now have player-created voice-over plugins, because voicing the story is a widely popular feature in good MMOs. We’re keeping the text and the speech bubbles for those who like them, but the voices convey a lot of nuance.

Our first set of voices for Ship of Heroes received mixed reviews when we rolled it out a few years ago.   People loved the voice idea, but they wanted some improvements to be made in the voices themselves.  Since that time, we’ve looked at quite a few options.  Today we are announcing that we have replaced the old voices with much superior new voices, giving a real improvement in the quality of the story telling.  We’ve also expanded the total number of spoken lines, and the number of individuals speaking, to improve immersion.

In the video that accompanies this newsletter, you can hear a few of the new voices. Many dev teams wouldn’t actually show a video without explosions or combat, just to illustrate an upgrade in storytelling mechanics.  But we’re really pleased with this upgrade, and we thought we’d share it with you today.

The accompanying video is a scene from the story arc that introduces mages and magic aboard the FHS Justice.  This arc has a lot of politics in it – players get different results and hear different dialog depending upon how they play the arc.  There is also an element of discovery in the arc.  So, the voiced lines give the players clues to what may be going on in the background between the senior mages who lead factions within the magical population of the ship. Again, the voices are important to telling the story in a subtle way.

We think the player-character should have an important role in the story.  If you save the world, when you return to your mission contact, they should say “Great work, you saved the world!”  The voices make this much more real. Voices also help the player understand why they need to save the world in a way the written text struggles to deliver.

In an MMO, other characters matter to the story as well.  In a good story, the other heroes, and the NPCs are doing things while you progress through your challenges.  The voices and dialog help to convey this complexity.  

Hearing the bantering dialog we often put into the game makes the NPCs seem more real. This is another huge advantage of having NPC voices for the dialog.

We’re continuing to polish our content and add features to make Ship of Heroes even more fun to play.  Stay tuned for more updates in the near future.  And please don’t forget to wishlist us on Steam! It will help us enormously when we launch.

Technical Notes:

1.	When your team takes a mission from a mission contact, everyone on the team can hear the dialog (not just the team leader) and can see any associated text pop-ups as well.  All of you are getting the mission together, and the voiced discussion, questions and answers, make a lot of difference.

2.	Settings in the menu allow players to select what they hear: sounds, music, voices, or any combination, or none at all.

3.	The hero’s name is written in the text, but not voiced to avoid mispronunciations.

4.	Adding player avatar voices is under consideration for after launch, but we will want to take the pulse of the community before we offer up this kind of upgrade.

notes.title: March - May 2024 Update
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43837291/65396dafd42a29fae2f9ab874626afb6f3323477.png

Raids

In the last few months, we have built and tested a raid UI. The raid UI ties in with our new multi-threaded chat system, so it is a pretty complex set of systems. Players are organized into color coded teams, each with one team leader, under one raid leader.  The raid UI is designed for a maximum number of 101 heroes with a maximum of 10 teams.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43837291/c5fd0ffccad06449d6f57dbae3da11864d227050.png

Side kicking is enabled, bringing lower level players to one level below the leader. Much information is conveyed in this UI and its functionality will be explained in an upcoming newsletter. Be sure to subscribe to learn more: https://shipofheroes.com/latest-news/  

In Ship of Heroes, raid leaders and team leaders have special powers to help them lead more effectively. This will be explained in an upcoming newsletter.

Voiceover

Ship of Heroes is an MMORPG with an original story, and voices bring this story to life. We originally tested player interest in this functionality in 2021 with a sample. This addition was received positively. Now, we are upgrading and expanding the voiceovers. The personality and mood of the NPCs is brought to life and contributes to the player’s immersion. We will publish more on this topic in an upcoming newsletter. You can subscribe here: https://shipofheroes.com/latest-news/  

Supporter Rewards

Supporters who donated at the Stylish level or above will have access to not one as promised, but two Supporter Capes available for all three body types. Their design is unique to Ship of Heroes. These capes are the only costume items not available to all Ship of Heroes subscribers. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43837291/83590b68cbbd33c2ea0d84e83540799aba710b3d.png

If you think you donated, you can check your donor rewards at https://shipofheroes.com/donation-rewards/, using the email with which you donated.

Animations

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43837291/5681386ab1f192912c8f15acbb4a919baab3d4a5.png
In the second half of last year, we started a comprehensive review and upgrade of our animations. With approximately 270 powers needing animations for each of the three body meshes and for on the ground and in-flight combat, this review is a major project. We are happy to report that we are seeing the end of the tunnel, with at least 80% of the work being completed already. Watch the new animations in future videos. Follow Ship of Heroes - YouTube.

In addition, taunt effectiveness and AoE radius on taunt have been upgraded.

QoL


 When you get a mission, a 3D mission locator now appears with a distance to your destination. It will guide you to the starting point of the mission whether you are on foot or flying.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43837291/642fc2d1ec185ac803236cd70a88672814fd0881.png


 Speed Lines can be disabled from Super Speed post process effects.
 Individual widgets in the game UI can now be resized independently. This adds to the scaling option in the game menu.


New Mission Arc

In the last few months, we have been pining down which content we will have at launch and are systematically going through it to polish it. 

While we have been focused on raids and polishing every aspect of the game, we have also added a new mission arc. In it, a member of the Red Sigil, a faction that deals in illegal and dangerous magical artifacts, gets really desperate, and….to be continued.

notes.title: February 2024 Update
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=OVpmktEHrX8;full][/previewyoutube]
In Ship of Heroes, you can create your character to exactly fit its story, your story. In this update, we create four very different characters and demonstrate how to use just a few of the features in the character creator.

Physical Appearances, Costumes, and Powers are Independent
This gives players complete freedom to create unique avatars. Ship of Heroes’ character creator offers a fantastic degree of customization, especially for an MMORPG. 

Character creation typically starts by selecting one of the 114 presets for the physical appearance: all of them can be used as-is, or massively edited through body morphs that aren't normally accessible to players. Adjustments to the body shape include height, measured in inches or centimeters, shoulder and arm width, body width, musculature, and more…The second character illustrates some of the possibilities, while the last two are mostly recolored. Nothing complicated.

Several hundred costume pieces can be mixed and matched interchangeably and will adjust to fit the unique body you create. They can be recolored as well. They are not locked in sets, though sets are available. All costume options are included in the price of the game.

Write a Backstory for your Character (optional) 
And of course, players can write a short backstory for every character they create; try reading the stories of heroes you see in the game some time. It’s fun! (Link to our unusual story)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43837291/fef19effb217b703b122bd7ea0935dbac4a728c1.png

Let’s look at how the four characters in the example are created.

The first character, Gadaphia, is a cyborg. Her cybernetic implants are similar to those of female Prometheans, but unlike them, she became a cyborg voluntarily.  In the 25th century, people can transform and alter themselves in many ways. Even regrowing limbs isn't much harder than changing clothes.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43837291/46aeef83df69f875e5fc620a13547ec563109011.png

She's proud of her beautiful human eyes and chooses to wear her vision-enhancing cybernetic implant only on one side. She adjusts its color to match her outfit.

Gadaphia decided that only one cybernetic arm would make it hard to get clothes that highlighted her single cybernetic arm but kept her other arm warm. Besides, how could she resist the lure of two gleaming metal arms immune to breakage? Definitely a plus for a dedicated Martial Arts practitioner!
For her lower body, she had to decide between cybernetic feet only, or whole legs. Choosing just the feet would have made it harder to employ her famous kicks. Besides, the lighted legs are so cool, and their color can also be changed on a whim! Getting dressed is greatly simplified, too.

All in all, Gadaphia is very happy with her selection of cybernetics. 

Next is Ryzali, a fierce alien warrior with a savage look. You don’t want to get on his bad side. What side would that be? He's not telling - not before going into attack mode. His build is strong and imposing, thanks to some adjustments to his body morphs, like larger hands and feet. No shoes for this tough dude. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43837291/8ef2abc63195e871beff3a0fcab463634de6c8f3.png

Another hint at his savagery comes from the bloody scars running over his brown body – the costume has been colored to nearly match his skin, suggesting they are one and the same.

For his head, preset #6 has been edited, starting with a pronounced back tilt of the face. His glowing lavender eyes have been sunken in with the eye depth slider, while his bushy eyebrow have been made as prominent as possible, lowered over his eyes, and given a striking light blond glow. A frown is his default expression.

While a bald crane or a mohawk also would have been effective choices, a wild hair style in red with hints of flaming red completes the fierce look. Pointy ears only emphasize his extra-terrestrial origins.

The next alien is nearly the opposite. Rainbow Angel has a sweet personality and a slightly ethereal quality suggested by her wispy aura. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43837291/bed1e79adf8507d1f6141adda9125e33b00e2269.png

The heart shape of the female #9 preset face was perfect to convey Rainbow Angel’s sweet disposition. All it took was adding ears and recoloring of skin, hair, eyes, eyebrows and lips to create her look. The pink tone of her skin pairs with her soft blue hair and calls for a soft turquoise and yellow-green color palette for her costume. Her delicate, feminine, but impractical silver shoes confirm what we suspected: she does not expect to fight.

Our third alien is also a formidable warrior, but quite different from the scarred one. He is part of a strong and disciplined fighting force whose role is to defend his group. Everything about him says “disciplined,” from his confident posture to his boldly colored breastplate.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43837291/cf80f8c3c3738eeecc90a1bc48a7a16cd1a20e37.png

His species is humanoid but characterized by a prominent external spine and the location of key organs in his upper thoracic cage, higher than in humans. 

His helmet protects his face without being too heavy and lets his colorful mohawk stand straight as a sign of bravery: he is not afraid to have his skull bashed. The color of his mohawk advertises the elite force to which he belongs.

This character could be made by replacing the hair style of any preset with the mohawk. It is all about the costume. 
 
We hope these examples inspire you to create your own unique character, or two, or three, or… Whether fanciful or realistic, human or humanoid, you'll be welcome aboard the FHS Justice.

Note: If all this seems too much, you can see how to make a good looking character quickly using presets and randomizers.

notes.title: January 2024 Update
notes.content:
Costumes and Character Creator

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43837291/00be8eea6efd5d6400e7255ad687c51e6bb759a0.png

notes.title: November 2023 Update
notes.content:
A Major Addition of Hair Styles

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43837291/691cd70894d349fd1b9c1d18bb81de7dcd8fff0d.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43837291/23f522732fc23b3f992da4ef5d83583d51628389.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43837291/bdc13d39993a231c21763a45ce1f3d2c828f29f1.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43837291/cfa488c497f671aa1a1588abbb96995d33b73617.png

9 new hair styles have been added for female characters, bringing the number of options to 26. The additions range from fancy bridal hair to neat short cut and includes a flattering ponytail with physics. All hair options can be applied to any of the 46 preset female heads available for customization. All hair options can be colorized with two color shades. Most options are illustrated in the 144 head presets available to players.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43837291/48dd3f33bad782aab8239b1e718f98e19669cfe4.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43837291/edb3bb5e40326f934a2bbb93421de80bf5304a93.png
5 new hair styles have also been added for male and big guy characters, bringing the total hair styles to 41 for males, and 17 for the big guy. As for females, all hair styles can be used on preset heads and colorized with two hair shades.

Environmental Improvements

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43837291/fed499993f848708b77595bd83170cc0d3c24dfb.png


We optimized the appearance of the city a bit, adding more color, polishing textures in a few spots, and making some visual upgrades in areas that had not received attention in a while.
We have also adjusted the skies and distance views and managed to eke out some moderate but important improvements in FPS. FPS always battle graphics quality in MMOs as there is so much more communication between server and client in an MMO than in a single or even multiplayer game. Our goal is to have a game that is enjoyable even if you do not have a top of the line computer and graphics card.
Apotheosis City is getting dressed up for Christmas.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43837291/bb52d1d2393770869efa85fbc4e2e64c16cb018b.png

Game Play

We refined our targeting, following feedback gathered during Steam Next Fest, and explained how it works in a newsletter.

Quality of Life Improvements

 Our big map now has a transparency slider. Those who want to keep the big map open can set the transparency to clearly view the game behind it.
 We made the key to switch between superspeed effects programmable for those without a numerical pad on their gaming laptop.
 Our largest window size was previously 1920 x 1080. We have added 4 larger sizes.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43837291/68e96c9b5d06a5937eca5c445fe83c7eef9f4e8d.png

Testing

Our pool of volunteer testers has almost doubled since our last update, and we are still looking for more testers, as there is a lot to test. You can sign up here to become a tester. You will have an opportunity to tell us what kind of testing you are interested in doing.

Updates You May Have Missed

Travel Powers 
https://shipofheroes.com/travel-powers-in-ship-of-heroes/
In Ship of Heroes, you can fly right from the start. Flying is tons of fun, yet very few modern MMORPGs have it. Better yet, flight is only one of three fast-travel powers in Ship of Heroes.

Power Augments
https://shipofheroes.com/power-augments-better-than-gear/ 
Power augments allow players to strengthen specific stats of different powers. They are Ship of Heroes’ version of gear upgrades, but your appearance and build are entirely independent. For example, you can improve the damage, accuracy, or recharge time of any power.

Targeting upgrades 
https://shipofheroes.com/targeting-upgrades-in-ship-of-heroes/ 
Targeting enemies in any game always draws a lot of opinions, and there’s a lot of subtlety to it. Tab targeting in particular is complex. You don’t need to worry about it when you’re playing because it’s intuitive to use. But behind this perceived simplicity is a bit of subtlety.

The New Camera Menu 
https://shipofheroes.com/the-new-camera-menu/ 
We’re adding a camera menu to the Interface options, to allow control of how the camera moves and where it is aimed relative to your character. This will accommodate individual preferences.

notes.title: October 2023 Update
notes.content:
Thank you to all who played our Beta during Steam Next Fest.  If you missed it, you can see playthrough videos. 

If you played in the Beta, please rate the level of difficulty by voting in our poll. 

We achieved our goals for the event and were able to test live our new multithreaded chat and new server structure. Our previous 9 Betas were conducted on our development server and with single threaded chat. The increasing number of participants to these events strained that system and made it clear that it was time to upgrade.

Demos in the Steam system are only accessible to players who do not already have the game in their library. This would have prevented our previous Beta participants from experiencing the Beta, so we implemented a workaround to enable everyone to play the Beta content.  

Testing

Thank you to all our testers for their efforts prior to Next Fest. This allowed us to enter Next Fest with zero known bugs, leaving us to focus on servers and multithreaded chat.

You can sign up here to become a tester. You will have an opportunity to tell us what kind of testing you are interested in doing.

QOL, Targeting, and Combat


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43837291/6b13bd01dffefddfa5d16350513e536c7cb93e75.png

We added a camera menu to accommodate various conflicting requests for improved camera settings. Our solution was our standard one: let the player choose.
New 3D targeting reticules replace decals on the ground. The new version is more visible at a distance and in uneven terrain.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43837291/dfc6c60c3d6fbcc05c0de10edd51075cf395c094.png

The number of line of sight checks used in targeting has been increased.
Superspeed has now been enabled for combat, just like flight.
We are systematically reviewing every one of our 200+ superpowers for animations, effects, and hit reactions.

Environment


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43837291/c39f6f557a89f49bbb1f402e9945f7043712025d.png
Just in time for Next Fest, we spruced up the warehouse district where the Engineering department is located.

New Enemies


 We created new Promethean enemy types with new powers. These add variety to combat and allow us to deepen the story. Prometheans are the evil cyborgs experienced in the first Sword Blossom arc of the demo.
 Four new monsters with a winter theme have been added.

Character Creator


 All shoes and boots now have working morphs.
 Some of our hundreds of costume pieces did not take advantage of all three customizable color channels. For those, we have enabled the 3rd color channel.

Tutorials

Steam Next Fest prompted us to start creating video tutorials. Subscribe to our YouTube channel to be notified of our new videos.

To receive more updates, subscribe to the Ship of Heroes Newsletter,

notes.title: Steam Next Fest October 2023
notes.content:
About the Next Fest Demo

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43837291/104dba80a879740acd0b7a2bf7d61cd9f97e0ab8.png

The demo includes the character creator and the first Sword Blossom arc, which focuses on the Engineering department aboard the FHS Justice and their quiet struggle against the Promethean menace and the evil Dr. Cornish. The arc contains seven missions, culminating in an intense battle to protect the FHS Justice and its inhabitants from assimilation. More about the Ship of Heroes story.


[previewyoutube=X5dGoLamOFU;full][/previewyoutube]

Our character creator has been expanded and streamlined. You can spend hours perfecting your character’s looks, or speed through using pre-styled faces and our very popular randomizer options.

Feel free to replay the arc with characters of different archetypes (5 of them) and/or different combinations of primary and secondary powersets, as they provide a different experience. Each set has several powers to choose from. You can create as many as 10 characters.

Every character will be topped up to 100,000 dust, the in-game currency, upon entering the demo, and will earn more for completing the missions. It’s enough to buy plenty of augments, infusions, and anything else you might want. Ship of Heroes' combat mechanics use a combination of powers, custom augments and temporary enhancements called infusions. Infusions can be bought from strategically placed vending machines like this one in the lobby of Engineering.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43837291/ab65b93cbd33c235a2646c90663709f28cd15cf3.png

Sign up to get complete updates or get notified of opportunities to play.

Help, Feedback, and Bug Report

All can be accessed on a dedicated demo page on our website.

We hope you enjoy the demo. If you do, please wishlist Ship of Heroes and leave a positive review.

September Update

This short list does not account for the many improvements that have been made during September.


Moved our servers to AWS to facilitate scaling up
Upgraded to multi-threaded chat
The entire collection of costumes has been reviewed
Completed an assessment of animations and effects for the over 200 powers and started working on improvements
Created visual guides for new and returnnig players
Improved the balance of difficulty in the arc
Made various small changes to improve the experience of new players
Tuned up our tab targeting

notes.title: August 2023 Update
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43837291/1ac6d4a4335bdf1114dfdcd59ef084eed8e92a8f.png

New NPCs


We added several new NPC types for the evil cyborg enemy faction, the Prometheans: the purifier, the hottest dude you don’t want to meet, and his counterpart, the mechanic. Why a mechanic? Because doctors object to working on evil cyborgs. 
We also added 7 other unique Promethean NPCs.
Being an engineer on Ship of Heroes is dangerous. That is why we have added 10 new armored engineer NPCs. They work on all 4 branches of Engineering, Life Support, Energy Distribution, Propulsion, and Weapons, defending their fellow engineers and the ship’s equipment. Engineering is one of the two largest departments on the ship.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43837291/cab70fad72e15fb3c7089fd3bd82ec94e6d06630.png

New Costumes

We continue to increase our costume collection. This month, we added 7 new costume pieces:

The new engineer armor, shoulders, arm bracers, and gloves are available to players for all three body types, male, female and big guy, and can be recolored. Like all our costume pieces, they can be used independently and combined with pieces of other costume sets.
We also added 3 female tops.  These were created by one of our female devs.


Missions

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43837291/f41cce2ab834817d18f84ca09be2a0d96bfc9812.png


We added a new four-mission arc, and we have been reviewing existing arcs with an eye to planning our next free public event.
We’ve conducted a detailed review of two of our foundational story arcs, in which the entire dev team played the missions through multiple times, checking and polishing.


Powers, Animations, and FX

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43837291/ac4f4a86958107c8948bee4f84b2c6eece43a9c2.png


Ship of Heroes currently includes 240 powers. We are currently reviewing all our powers’ animations and effects. 
We added unique death animations and FX for Prometheans.  When an evil cyborg created by a fusion of banned technology and dark magic is killed, something special should happen, right? 


Quality of Life Improvements

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43837291/75288e47446ffb175327bd2fb519e83439507a02.png


Different types of sounds can now be individually adjusted or toggled off.  Want to dial down the footsteps, or the sounds of gunfire and explosions?  You got it.
In the mission journal, we made the list of goals collapsible to minimize the size of that window.
When Unobtanium Dust, the in-game currency, drops, the dust count display animates and turns yellow to highlight the drop. The animation also plays when opening the vendor window.


Please add Ship of Heroes to your wishlist

Learn more about Ship of Heroes
